# TripBeam

> > TripBeam is a travel booking platform specializing in affordable flights from the United States to India and international destinations.

TripBeam focuses on connecting US cities like Chicago, Seattle, Orlando, and Oakland to major Indian cities including Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Chennai, Amritsar, and Trivandrum. The platform offers last-minute flight deals, discount airfare, and comprehensive travel booking services with partnerships across major airlines including United Airlines and Air India.

## Key Topics

- US to India flights
- Cheap international flights
- Last-minute flight deals
- Discount airfare
- India destinations (Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Chennai, Amritsar, Trivandrum, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Cochin, Jaipur, Goa)
- Flight booking services
- United Airlines
- Air India
- International travel deals
- Low-cost flights
- USA to India travel
- Flight deals and offers
- TripBeam booking platform
